tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultancy Firm/Company should have successfully completed minimum of 2 DPR Works as Prime consultant in similar nature of crematorium Works in Past 3 years in Karnataka state only. In support of this, the Consultant shall furnish Certificates duly certified by the Competent Authority of Rank not below the Executive Engineer

Achieved at least a minimum annual Financial Turnover (in all classes of Civil Engineering Consultation Works only) of Rs. 50.00 Lakhs in any one financial Year from the last three Financial Years (i.e.,2023-2026). In support of this, the Consultant shall furnish the Audited Balance Sheets along with the Technical Proposal

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultancy Firm/Company should have Past Experience & Exposure in Preparation of DPRs in Past 3 years in Karnataka state only. In support of this, the Consultant shall furnish Certificates duly certified by the Competent Authority of Rank not below the Executive Engineer.

Consultants must have Key professional required (as detailed in Terms of Reference) having experience in construction supervision of works to be deployed exclusively for this consultancy contract. The employer or competent authority shall furnish the CVs of the personnel and the availability of the personnel for the project till completion of the assignment

The consultants are advised to visit the sites and study the site conditions and the same should be certified by the concerned engineer in charge of the work before submission of their Proposal, or else the proposals will not be considered for evaluation
Consultants Must Have A valid ISO certificate as consultancy services provider as per ISO 9001:2015.
Consultant should have Established Office locally and should be running office from past 3 years. Proof of certificate should be submitted
Joint Tenders are not allowed. The offer of the Consultant, who does not qualify for the above pre-qualification norms, will not be considered for further evaluation
